BASS ONLY. Bass is the ONLY instrument allowed. No drums, percussion, piano, keys, guitar, synth, pads, strings, orchestra, brass, woodwinds, traditional instruments, or any other instruments. No additional instrumental layers or drum sounds.
Use bass only for groove, pulse, tension, movement, minimal harmony, and Bass Drop energy. Keep the arrangement extremely minimal and vocal-focused. Create a short, catchy vocal hook based on the song's core emotion. Build tension with space and minimal bass before the drop, then bring in a strong Bass Drop with the repeated vocal hook.
Modern, emotional, cinematic, restrained, powerful, addictive. No live, concert, crowd, or stadium atmosphere.
